description: This Java class 'SendReq' extends 'MultimediaMessagePdu' and represents an MMS send request message (PDU), providing constructors for creating and setting various headers and properties related to MMS messages, such as content type, address fields, transaction ID, and delivery parameters.

classes.name: SendReq
classes.description: Represents an MMS send request (PDU) with methods to set and get message headers and fields.

methods.name: SendReq
methods.description: Default constructor that initializes the message with default headers such as message type, MMS version, content type, sender address, and transaction ID.

methods.name: generateTransactionId
methods.description: Generates a unique transaction ID based on the current system time in hexadecimal.

methods.name: SendReq
methods.description: Constructor to create a SendReq object with specified content type, sender address, MMS version, and transaction ID.

methods.name: SendReq
methods.description: Constructor to initialize using provided headers.

methods.name: SendReq
methods.description: Constructor to initialize using provided headers and body.
